name: embedded-common-shell
description: 範例：宿主 iframe 外殼 + 獨立的 Common SPA，透過 postMessage 溝通

scripts.dev: concurrently -n host,common -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w host" "npm run dev -w common"
scripts.build: npm run build -w host && npm run build -w common
scripts.preview: concurrently -n host,common -c blue,magenta "npm run preview -w host" "npm run preview -w common"
